annotations.title: Add the web to an app, or change what it is

description: Adds the web to one of the person's apps, at a free <address>.ploa.app, or changes what an app's web is. kind: 'app' (the app itself in the browser), 'site' (pages about the app, linking to its store apps) or 'both' (the pages at the address, the web app under /app); pwa: installable to the home screen. An app with store apps on both platforms needs no PWA on phones (people should get the store apps): leave pwa off unless the person wants it on computers, and then point phones at the stores (the manifest's prefer_related_applications with its Google Play app, and Apple's apple-itunes-app smart banner meta; Ploa's check 'storesFirst' says what's missing). An app with no store apps can be web only. Ask the person which address they want and what the web is; don't pick for them. Ploa sells no domains: a domain they own connects later (ploa_web_domain_add).

address.description: The part before .ploa.app (3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and dashes). For a new web only.

appId.description: The app it's the web of.

name.description: What to call it in the dashboard (default: the app's name).

pwa.description: Installable (a PWA). Off by default; with store apps on both platforms, only if the person wants it on computers.

site.description: The site's address (the part before .ploa.app) or ID. Needed when the workspace has more than one site.
